notes_for_human: Greenhouse board 'walleyecapital-external-students' lists 11 Summer 2027 internship postings total (Business Operations, CEQR, Equity Volatility Quant Research, Fundamental Equities, Investment Data Science, Investor Relations, Quantic PhD Quant Researcher, Quantic Quant Developer, Quantic Quant Researcher, Risk Technology Analyst, Technology, Volatility Trading Developer). Only the 3 above (Investment Data Science, Technology, Fundamental Equities) were individually fetched and quote-verified from the job posting itself; the other 8 were seen only in the board's title/location listing (boards-api.greenhouse.io JSON) and were NOT opened, so their class-year, sponsorship, pay, and cooling-off text is unverified pending direct fetch. The 3 verified postings share near-identical template language on pay ($14,000/month + $10,000 housing stipend + domestic-only transportation) and a July 31, 2026 11:59pm ET application deadline, which is very likely the same deadline for the unverified postings but that is an inference, not a confirmed fact. Sponsorship policy ('Yes, we support work authorization for international intern candidates') comes from the general walleyecapital.com/campus-faq page, not from the individual job postings, which only present a sponsorship-need application question without stating firm policy. Tier-3 aggregator sites (Tealhq, ZipRecruiter, Lensa, MIT Sloan CDO, Harvard FAS reposts, Wikipedia) appeared in search results and were used only to locate the Greenhouse board URL and program names — no quotes were sourced from them, per rules. No reapplication/cooling-off policy was found anywhere reviewed (campus-faq page or job postings).
